note: iPhone Duo pre-orders open today at 1pm UK time.

front.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
front.tldr: Tesla's redesigned Roadster used compressed-air thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Semi, Model Y and Model 3 at a Texas demo, previewing the car's planned flight mode.

front.title: iPhone Duo pre-orders open today
front.tldr: From 5am Pacific time today, customers can pre-order Apple's new iPhone Duo on apple.com and in the Apple Store app, ahead of its retail launch.

front.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
front.tldr: Meta and Apple worked together on Muse Spark Open, a new open-weight model that runs locally on Apple silicon, extending their collaboration beyond hardware into on-device AI.

stories.title: Cal AI's viral success was built on a small army of paid influencers
stories.tldr: Calorie-tracking app Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue in two years before MyFitnessPal acquired it, built largely through paid influencer marketing rather than traditional ads.

stories.title: Amazon's Panos Panay predicts AI devices will replace the need to use apps
stories.tldr: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon's devices chief described a future where ambient AI devices anticipate what people need in the background, rather than waiting for them to open an app.

stories.title: Chirp Pong: a two-player game that syncs over audio chirps between phones
stories.tldr: Developer Simon Willison built Chirp Pong, a two-player browser game that syncs state between separate phones using audio chirps instead of a network connection.

stories.title: Anthropic gives METR researchers employee-level access to its systems
stories.tldr: Anthropic has given AI safety group METR employee-level access and given up the right to block its findings, so METR can publish its own assessments of Anthropic's risks and incidents.

stories.title: Intero Biosystems wins Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026
stories.tldr: Intero Biosystems beat 199 other companies to take the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield this week.

stories.title: E Ink's new Kaleido 4 display improves colour e-readers
stories.tldr: E Ink's Kaleido 4 panel offers better colour reproduction and faster refresh rates, another step towards a genuinely good colour e-reader.

stories.title: Figma adds new features for how AI agents work on its platform
stories.tldr: Figma is releasing new tools to define how AI agents operate within its design platform, and is also opening its code layers feature to open beta.

stories.title: Volvo deepens its Nvidia partnership for hands-free driving
stories.tldr: Volvo is expanding its near decade-long partnership with Nvidia to extend hands-free automated driving beyond its battery-electric models.

stories.title: Apple's new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini 2 cost more than their predecessors
stories.tldr: John Gruber tallies the price rises behind Apple's new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini 2, which push the cost of a combination that was $350 before June noticeably higher.

stories.title: New Withings users must pay $99 a year for Apple Health syncing
stories.tldr: Withings now requires customers who create an account from 13 October 2026 onward to subscribe to Withings+ for automatic Apple Health syncing, gating a feature that was previously free.

stories.title: Apple closes in on Samsung despite record smartphone shipment decline
stories.tldr: IDC says Apple's global iPhone shipments fell 4% year-on-year in Q3 2026, even as its share of the shrinking smartphone market rose to 23.1%.

stories.title: Apple's marketing chief says Apple Intelligence is for 'everyday people', not the 'lunatic fringe'
stories.tldr: In an interview with TIME, Apple marketing chief Greg Joswiak said Apple Intelligence is built for ordinary users rather than the AI power users he called the 'lunatic fringe'.

stories.title: 'Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald' review: Judd Apatow's haunting portrait of a comedy star
stories.tldr: Variety's review of Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald finds a comic as troubled as he was hilarious, with a streak of Andy Kaufman's antisocial edge.

stories.title: Steven Soderbergh steps in to finish filming The Batman Part II
stories.tldr: Soderbergh is helping complete the final weeks of principal photography on The Batman Part II while director Matt Reeves attends to a family matter.

stories.title: Denis Villeneuve explains why he chose Bond after finishing Dune 3
stories.tldr: Villeneuve told Empire he returned for a third, final Dune so he could be 'severe with the material', and that directing the new James Bond film will be his next 'powerful rocket'.

stories.title: Jenna Ortega hopes 'Klara and the Sun' encourages people to put down their phones
stories.tldr: At the London premiere of her dystopian sci-fi film Klara and the Sun, Jenna Ortega said she hopes it reminds audiences to live in the moment rather than stay lost in technology.

stories.title: Jayson Tatum and Mitchell Robinson shine together in preseason win over Hornets
stories.tldr: Tatum and Robinson looked like a problem for opposing defences in the Celtics' third straight preseason win, this time over the Hornets.

stories.title: Celtics debut new twin-tower lineup in third straight preseason win
stories.tldr: Boston beat Charlotte 113-94 for a third consecutive preseason win, with a new twin-tower lineup among the game's notable takeaways.

stories.title: Payton Pritchard is adding another dimension to his game
stories.tldr: Known for shooting, Pritchard passed up an open three in Boston's preseason win to set up an even more open Baylor Scheierman look, a small sign of a more unselfish game.

stories.title: Patriots vs. Jets preview for NFL Week 6
stories.tldr: New England host the Jets on Sunday, a meeting between two second-year head coaches who have had very different levels of success so far this season.

stories.title: A.J. Brown's return status still 'up in the air' for Sunday
stories.tldr: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown returned to practice this week for the first time since a high ankle sprain in Week 1, but his availability against the Jets remains unclear.

stories.title: Rafael Camara to make F1 debut with Haas in 2027, replacing Esteban Ocon
stories.tldr: Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara will make his Formula 1 debut for Haas in 2027 alongside Oliver Bearman, replacing Esteban Ocon.

stories.title: Lando Norris's business empire: Quadrant, LN4 Fusion and Seat Unique explained
stories.tldr: Beyond racing, Norris's business portfolio now spans a gaming brand founded in lockdown, a junior racing team and a stake in a ticketing platform, each betting on a different industry.

stories.title: Payton Tolle was immaculate for the 2026 Red Sox
stories.tldr: Looking back at Boston's 2026 season, Over the Monster highlights Payton Tolle's standout year as one of its most memorable moments.

finally.title: 'Welcoming and inclusive' London housing wins RIBA Stirling Prize 2026
finally.tldr: Lion Green Road, a south London housing scheme by Mary Duggan Architects with Ruff Architects, has won the RIBA Stirling Prize for the UK's best new building.
